name: Menubar
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Menubar(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

MenubarCheckIndicator.description: The animated check drawn at the end of a checkbox or radio item (Appica's indicator)

MenubarCheckboxItem.description: A toggleable item with a check indicator. Keeps the menu open and dispatches `ui--menubar:checked-change` with { checked, item }.

MenubarContent.description: The popup for a menu. It opens below its trigger (to the inline-end side in a vertical bar) and flips when there isn't room.

MenubarGroup.description: One labelled section of a menu; give it a MenubarGroupLabel

MenubarGroupLabel.description: The visible heading of a MenubarGroup or MenubarRadioGroup

MenubarItem.description: One action. Selecting it (click, Enter or Space) dispatches `ui--menubar:select` and closes the menu; `close_on_click: false` keeps it open. Tag a leading icon `data: { icon: "start" }` and push a trailing Kbd to the edge with `class: "ms-auto"`.

MenubarLinkItem.description: An item that renders an <a> for navigation

MenubarMenu.description: Wraps one menu in the bar: a trigger and its popup

MenubarRadioGroup.description: A set of mutually exclusive MenubarRadioItems. Choosing one dispatches `ui--menubar:value-change` with { value, group }.

MenubarRadioItem.description: One option in a MenubarRadioGroup. Keeps the menu open when chosen.

MenubarSeparator.description: A thin divider between items or groups

MenubarSub.description: A nested submenu: MenubarSubTrigger plus MenubarSubContent

MenubarSubContent.description: The submenu popup. Opens to the inline-end side of its trigger, flipping near the edge.

MenubarSubTrigger.description: The item that opens a submenu, with a trailing chevron. Opens on hover, click or →.

MenubarTrigger.description: The top-level label that opens its menu. Once a menu is open, hovering a sibling trigger switches to it; arrow keys move along the bar.

examples.name: Application menu
examples.notes:
A desktop-style command bar: File, Edit and View menus with shortcuts, separators,
a nested "Open recent" submenu and a disabled item.

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes:
`variant: :pill` (default) gives each trigger a hover/active pill; `variant: :line` draws
an animated underline, closer to a classic desktop menu bar.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-8") do
    [ :pill, :line ].each do |variant|
      Menubar(variant:, aria_label: "#{variant.to_s.capitalize} menubar") do
        [ "File", "Edit", "View" ].each do |label|
          MenubarMenu do
            MenubarTrigger { label }
            MenubarContent do
              MenubarItem { "Action one" }
              MenubarItem { "Action two" }
              MenubarItem { "Action three" }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Vertical
examples.notes:
`orientation: :vertical` stacks the menus into a sidebar; each menu opens to the
inline-end side. Triggers take a leading icon (`data: { icon: "start" }`).
examples.code:
phlex do
  Menubar(orientation: :vertical, aria_label: "Workspace", class: "w-35") do
    { "Overview" => [ :layout_dashboard, [ "Summary", "Activity" ] ], "Projects" => [ :folder, [ "All projects", "New project", nil, "Archived" ] ],
      "Team" => [ :users, [ "Members", "Invitations" ] ], "Settings" => [ :settings, [ "General", "Billing" ] ] }.each do |label, (icon, items)|
      MenubarMenu do
        MenubarTrigger do
          Icon(icon, data: { icon: "start" })
          plain label
        end
        MenubarContent do
          items.each { |item| item ? MenubarItem { item } : MenubarSeparator() }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Submenus
examples.notes:
Nest a MenubarSub with its own MenubarSubTrigger and MenubarSubContent. It opens to the
side on hover or with the arrow keys, flipping near a screen edge.

examples.name: Checkbox & radio items
examples.notes:
MenubarCheckboxItem toggles; a MenubarRadioGroup of MenubarRadioItems picks one value.
Both keep the menu open and dispatch `ui--menubar:checked-change` / `value-change`.

examples.name: Leading icons
examples.notes:
A leading icon on `data: { icon: "start" }` works on triggers and items; a trailing Kbd
is pushed to the edge with `class: "ms-auto"`.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Menubar(aria_label: "Application") do
    MenubarMenu do
      MenubarTrigger do
        Icon(:file_text, data: { icon: "start" })
        plain "File"
      end
      MenubarContent do
        MenubarItem do
          Icon(:file_plus, data: { icon: "start" })
          plain "New file"
          Kbd(size: :sm, class: "ms-auto") { "⌘N" }
        end
        MenubarItem do
          Icon(:folder, data: { icon: "start" })
          plain "Open…"
          Kbd(size: :sm, class: "ms-auto") { "⌘O" }
        end
        MenubarSeparator()
        MenubarItem do
          Icon(:download, data: { icon: "start" })
          plain "Save"
          Kbd(size: :sm, class: "ms-auto") { "⌘S" }
        end
      end
    end
    MenubarMenu do
      MenubarTrigger do
        Icon(:pencil, data: { icon: "start" })
        plain "Edit"
      end
      MenubarContent do
        { arrow_back_up: "Undo", arrow_forward_up: "Redo", nil => nil, scissors: "Cut", copy: "Copy", clipboard: "Paste" }.each do |icon, label|
          if label
            MenubarItem do
              Icon(icon, data: { icon: "start" })
              plain label
            end
          else
            MenubarSeparator()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    MenubarMenu do
      MenubarTrigger do
        Icon(:eye, data: { icon: "start" })
        plain "View"
      end
      MenubarContent do
        { zoom_in: "Zoom in", zoom_out: "Zoom out" }.each do |icon, label|
          MenubarItem do
            Icon(icon, data: { icon: "start" })
            plain label
          end
        end
        MenubarSeparator()
        MenubarItem do
          Icon(:maximize, data: { icon: "start" })
          plain "Enter full screen"
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
The bar lays out from the right, arrow keys reverse, and popups and submenus open
towards the inline end.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl") do
    Menubar(aria_label: "التطبيق") do
      { "ملف" => [ "ملف جديد", "فتح…", "حفظ" ], "تحرير" => [ "تراجع", "إعادة", "نسخ" ], "عرض" => [ "تكبير", "تصغير" ] }.each do |label, items|
        MenubarMenu do
          MenubarTrigger { label }
          MenubarContent do
            items.each { |item| MenubarItem { item } }
            if label == "ملف"
              MenubarSub do
                MenubarSubTrigger { "فتح الأخيرة" }
                MenubarSubContent do
                  MenubarItem { "project-alpha" }
                  MenubarItem { "landing-page" }
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
